body:
```
apps/
  chrome-ext/                MV3 host — Vite + React + Tailwind v4
    public/manifest.json     MV3 manifest (action, service worker, content_scripts, web_accessible_resources)
    src/app/                 Main viewer page (library shell, adapters, registry, intercept pickup)
    src/background/          Service worker (dev reload + icon click → open tab)
    src/content/             file:// interception
    src/styles/              Tailwind v4 + design tokens driven by [data-theme]
packages/
  viewer-core/               @file-viewer/core — types, ThemeProvider, adapter interfaces, memory defaults
  mdx-viewer/                @file-viewer/mdx — the renderer (host-agnostic)
pnpm-workspace.yaml
tsconfig.base.json
```

Workspace root builds viewer packages first (tsup), then the host app (Vite). Each viewer package ships ESM + `.d.ts` and declares React as a peer.
